desc.day: The room is stuffy. Dust hangs in a bar of window light.
desc.evening: Streetlight leaks orange through the blinds. Pipes knock somewhere below.
desc.night: Dark. The mini-fridge hums. Your phone glows on the nightstand.

actions.label: Lie down for a while
actions.text: You drift off to the radiator's ticking and wake with a crease on your cheek.

actions.label: Study from your own books
text: You open a battered textbook and work through it one stubborn page at a time.
You copy out notes, then close the book and try to recite them.

actions.label: Do push-ups and stretches
actions.text: You count reps until the floor feels very close and very far away.

actions.label: Sit down with the laptop and get some work done
actions.text: You open the client portal and start typing. The hours slide by.

win.text: The client approves the work and pays on time. +#35

lose.text: The client nitpicks every line and pays half. +#12

desc.morning: Delivery vans idle outside shuttered shops. A man hoses down the sidewalk in front of the barber.
desc.day: Main Street is slow: pickups, a school bus, two old men arguing on a bench.
desc.evening: Shop windows flicker on. People walk home with grocery bags.
desc.night: The stoplight blinks yellow for nobody. A dog barks three streets over.

actions.label: Help the {eatery} out by handing out flyers
actions.text: Most people take a flyer just to be polite. A few even smile.

actions.label: Trail a distracted tourist a little too closely
actions.text: You drift close, eyes on the shop window, hand low.

win.text: Light fingers. A thin wallet changes hands. +#35

lose.text: A hand clamps your wrist. You wrench free and run, but people saw your face.

actions.label: Try to sleep on a bench
actions.text: The bench is cold and the night is long. You sleep in pieces.

actions.label: Run laps around the block
text: Your lungs burn by the second lap. You do a third anyway.
The same corners, a little faster each time.

actions.label: Practice talking to strangers
text: You ask for directions you don't need and try to make the answer a conversation.
You practice a smile in a shop window, then try it on a real person.

actions.label: Watch people go by
text: A kid leads a very reluctant goat down the road.
Two cousins argue over a parking spot, then hug.
Someone's truck backfires and the whole street flinches.

actions.label: Strike up a conversation with someone

desc.morning: Bacon fat, burnt coffee, and the clatter of plates. {cook} works the counter with a pot in each hand.
desc.day: Lunch rush: every booth full, the grill hissing.
desc.evening: Quieter now. A trucker nurses a slice of pie at the counter.
desc.night: Fluorescent lights buzz. {cook} wipes the counter in slow circles.

actions.label: Sit down for a proper meal (@9)
actions.text: Meatloaf, mash, green beans. Honest food.

actions.label: Order a coffee (@3)
actions.text: Strong, bitter, bottomless if {cook} likes you.

actions.label: Work on your laptop with a coffee (3h, @3)
actions.text: You open the client portal and start typing. The hours slide by.

win.text: The client approves the work and pays on time. +#35

lose.text: The client nitpicks every line and pays half. +#12

actions.label: Talk with {cook} for a bit
text: She tells you who in town owes who money.
{cook} gives you advice you didn't ask for. It's good.
She asks how the city kid is holding up. You lie a little.

actions.label: Strike up a conversation with someone

desc.morning: A kid buys a lottery scratcher with sleepy seriousness. The clerk watches the door.
desc.day: Humming coolers, shelves a little dusty. The clerk, {clerk}, reads a paperback.
desc.evening: Neon beer signs buzz in the window. The place smells of floor cleaner.
desc.night: Bright and empty. {clerk}'s eyes follow you down each aisle.

actions.label: Slip something into your jacket when the clerk looks away
actions.text: You pick your moment. {clerk} turns to the register.

win.text: It disappears into your jacket. You walk out calm.

lose.text: "Hey!" {clerk} is faster than he looks. He takes it back and tells you not to return.

actions.label: Buy a scratch card (@2)
actions.text: You scrape the silver coating off with a coin.

win.text: Three matching symbols. The clerk raises an eyebrow. +#30

lose.text: Nothing. You flick the dust off your thumb.

desc.morning: Quiet and cool. The librarian stamps cards by hand.
desc.day: Dust, old paper, and one very good wifi router.
desc.evening: The reading lamps hum. Someone's asleep over a atlas.

actions.label: Settle in and study
actions.text: You pick a corner and read until the words stop sliding off.

actions.label: Work on your laptop at a library desk (3h)
actions.text: You open the client portal and start typing. The hours slide by.

win.text: The client approves the work and pays on time. +#35

lose.text: The client nitpicks every line and pays half. +#12

actions.label: Work through old exam papers
text: Question after question. Some answers come easy. Some you have to fight for.
You mark your own work honestly, which hurts a little.

actions.label: Read the town paper
text: Zoning dispute. Lost cat. A feud over a fence.
Pie contest results. The runner-up is already contesting them.

actions.label: Strike up a conversation with someone

desc.morning: Rubber mats, chalk dust, a radio playing classic rock.
desc.day: A few regulars. Nobody talks. Everybody nods.
desc.evening: The after-work crowd grunts through sets.
desc.night: Dim lights and a lone lifter in the corner.

actions.label: Work out (@8)
actions.text: You push until your arms shake. It feels like progress.

actions.label: Strike up a conversation with someone

desc.morning: Antiseptic and old magazines. The nurse nods you in.
desc.day: A cough from the waiting room. A child's drawing on the wall.
desc.evening: Almost empty. A vending machine hums.

actions.label: See the doctor (@40)
actions.text: The doctor is brisk and kind. You leave patched up.

desc.morning: Wet brick and trash bags. Someone's left a sleeping bag under the fire escape.
desc.evening: A man named Rook leans on a dumpster, watching you.
desc.night: Shadows pool by the dumpsters. Someone laughs, low, further down.

actions.label: See what Rook has behind the counter
Run an errand for Rook
actions.text: Rook slides you a paper bag. "Corner of Mill and Third. Don't look inside."

win.text: The drop goes smooth. Rook peels off a few bills. +#45

lose.text: A rival crew finds you before the drop. You walk away bruised and empty-handed.

actions.label: Practice sleight of hand with a coin
actions.text: The coin walks across your knuckles. It drops. You pick it up and do it again.

desc.morning: Cranes groan, gulls scream, forklifts beep. The air tastes of salt and diesel.
desc.day: Containers stack like a town of their own.
desc.evening: Shift change. Tired men file out past the gate.
desc.night: Floodlights hum over empty yards. Water laps the pilings.

actions.label: Watch the ships come and go
actions.text: A rust-red freighter slides out to sea. You wonder where it goes.

desc.morning: {Workplace}. A familiar routine is waiting for you here.
desc.day: {Workplace}. The day is in full swing.

desc.morning: Shutters rattle up one by one. Delivery vans block half the pavement.
desc.day: A short row of shops and a smell of coffee, hot pavement and cardboard.
desc.evening: Windows glow. Everybody is either finishing a day or starting an evening.
desc.night: Most of the row is dark. A security light hums over the pharmacy door.

actions.label: Window-shop for a while
actions.text: You drift along the glass, spending nothing and wanting a little.

desc.morning: Crates of produce are still being stacked. The floor is damp.
desc.day: Scales, price cards and a radio low in the back.
desc.evening: Tired tomatoes marked down by half.
desc.night: Shuttered and dark, the sign buzzing.

desc.morning: The pharmacist is unlocking cabinets. Everything smells of mint and clean plastic.
desc.day: Quiet shelves of boxes with careful names.
desc.evening: The last customers murmur at the counter.
desc.night: Shuttered and dark, the sign buzzing.

desc.morning: Demo screens loop their bright, silent clips.
desc.day: Glass cases of phones and a wall of cables.
desc.evening: Fluorescent light, dull music, the faint smell of new plastic.
desc.night: Shuttered and dark, the sign buzzing.

desc.morning: Racks of new stock still smelling of the warehouse.
desc.evening: A mannequin in a coat that costs more than your week.
desc.night: Shuttered and dark, the sign buzzing.

desc.morning: Sawdust and rubber and the crackle of an old radio.
desc.day: Aisles of screws, pipes and homely ambition.
desc.evening: A lone customer debating paint with great seriousness.
desc.night: Shuttered and dark, the sign buzzing.

desc.morning: The bell over the door rings for you alone.
desc.day: Paperback spines in rows and a cat asleep on the poetry.
desc.evening: Soft lamps, soft music, a basket of cards by the till.
desc.night: Shuttered and dark, the sign buzzing.
